rust_declaration.name: as_flattened

trusted_assumptions: The lower specification for <[T]>::as_ptr yields a valid raw slice whose view equals the input slice.
The lower raw-pointer cast specification preserves the pointer under element-type casting.
The lower usize::unchecked_mul specification returns mathematical multiplication when the product fits.
The lower core::slice::from_raw_parts specification returns the valid raw view with the requested length.
The vstd specifications for size_of, checked_mul, and Option::expect model the corresponding smaller operations.
axiom_array_slice_flattened_length_fits: a valid non-ZST slice of arrays has len * N fitting in usize.
axiom_raw_array_slice_reinterpretation: casting contiguous [T; N] storage to T preserves validity and produces the row-major flattened raw view.
rationale: The Rust 1.96 control flow and operations are preserved. T::IS_ZST is mechanically expanded to its default SIZE == 0 definition; two explicit layout axioms bridge Verus's unavailable raw-memory representation model.
